summary: 12 smoke tests were failing because the sample data pointed at thumbnails that don't exist for the new story templates. Fixed it and added a test that catches broken images.
why: Red smoke tests block every dashboard merge, so this bug came first. Sample data only; the live site was not affected.

findings.title: Sample thumbnails 404 for short_story / long_story
findings.detail: Since cf14172 (2026-10-17) public/sample/ only had art for the retired templates; 12 of 34 smoke tests failed on console 404s.

findings.title: Templates: Long story card cramped on phones
findings.detail: Logged in the backlog for a later night.

changes.title: Sample store uses art that exists
changes.detail: short_story borrows a retired template's art, long_story has none (like the DB store). New smoke test: no broken images on Overview, Queue, Videos, Templates.
